Fees and Deposit

Expect a $250 minimum deposit. Fees and spreads can change, so check the current terms before you fund anything, and be wary of any promise that trading is free of cost.

The Main Risks

The biggest risk is not knowing who you are dealing with. If a platform is unregulated, complaints and withdrawals can be hard to pursue. Automated trading removes work, not market risk.

Frequently Asked Questions

What’s the minimum deposit for Hexonix Core?

The minimum deposit is $250.

No regulator could be confirmed. Verify any claim directly with the regulator.

Does Hexonix Core charge platform fees?

Can automated trading lose money?

No. Losses are possible with any trading, automated or not.

Where We Land on Hexonix Core

With no confirmed operator or regulator, Hexonix Core is best approached with care. The rating sits in our usual band and is a general assessment, not an endorsement.

Deposit the $250 minimum only, use demo mode first, and never trade money you cannot afford to lose.
